title: Contrivance
author: phil_the
rules:
Solve in Penpa+

U-Bahn:

In the main 9x9 grid, draw an orthogonally connected loop network between the centres of some cells. The loop may branch and cross itself but must never end in the middle of a cell.
Fill the areas above and to the left of the grid with values equal to the number of corners, straights, branches, crosses and empty cells.

Dutch Flatmates:

Any 5 in the outside areas must have a 1 immediately above or a 9 immediately below it. It may have both but does not need both.

Battenberg:

In the outside areas, every 2x2 area where one diagonal contains only even numbers and the other diagonal only odd numbers, a Battenberg symbol is given. All such battenbergs are given.

U-Bahttenberg:

In the main 9x9 grid, a Battenberg symbol is given for every 2x2 area where the same shape (irrespective of rotation) appears on both cells of one diagonal with a different shape on both cells of the other diagonal. All such battenbergs are given.
solutionCode: Number of corners in bottom row
